title: Energizer™ Bunny Totem
description: Replaces the "Totem of Undying" to the Energizer™ Mascot.
body:
Replaces the "Totem of undying" with the bunny from the Energizer™ ads. 
The totem is called "Totem of Energizer".
Model and texturing is by me @Noobsavior12 using Blockbench.
If you have any trobles please DM me on discord. if you want a update or a back port then DM!
